import html # Predefined template with placeholders for author, title, body and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Args: author: The name of the post's author. title: The post's title. body: The main content of the post. post_tags: A list of tags associated with the post. Returns: str: The fully rendered and sanitized HTML string. """ # Escape all user supplied content to prevent XSS safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) # Preserve newlines in body by converting to
safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Render tags as individual elements, escaped safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)} ' for tag in post_tags ).strip() # Fill the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags ) return rendered.strip()
